entries.label: HWLD_PRE_ZOMBIE_HELLO_1
entries.body:
Why HELLO human Earthling! Har! Har! Har!
Must say, your appearance here comes as quite surprise to us!
We never expected to see any of you ever again
after our Ur-Quan masters put your species under slave shield!
entries.source:
Why HELLO human Earthling! Har! Har! Har!
Must say, your appearance here comes as quite surprise to us!
We never expected to see any of you ever again
after our Ur-Quan masters put your species under slave shield!
entries.translation:
哎呀你好，人類地球人！ 哈！哈！哈！
必須說，你出現在這裡讓我 們好驚訝！
烏爾關主人把你們物種關進 奴役護盾後
我們從沒想過還會再見到你 們！

entries.label: HWLD_PRE_ZOMBIE_HELLO_2
entries.body:
Hey look everybody! Human Earthling came back!
Har! Har! Har! Say, I wonder we'll kill him this time?
Har! Har! Har!
entries.source:
Hey look everybody! Human Earthling came back!
Har! Har! Har! Say, I wonder we'll kill him this time?
Har! Har! Har!
entries.translation:
嘿，大家快看！ 人類地球人回來了！
哈！哈！哈！喂， 不知道我們這次怎麼殺他？
哈！哈！哈！

entries.label: HWLD_PRE_ZOMBIE_HELLO_3
entries.body: You're back? Har! Har! Har! More fun! More fun!
entries.source: You're back? Har! Har! Har! More fun! More fun!
entries.translation: 你回來了？哈！哈！哈！ 更多樂子！更多樂子！

entries.label: HWLD_PRE_ZOMBIE_HELLO_4
entries.body: Howdy human Earthling! Back for more fun?
entries.source: Howdy human Earthling! Back for more fun?
entries.translation: 你好啊，人類地球人！ 回來找更多樂子？

entries.label: SPACE_PRE_ZOMBIE_HELLO_1
entries.body:
Well bloat my belly! It's a human Earthling!
Har! Har! Har! Haven't seen a human Earthling since... since
why heck! NEVER seen a human Earthling!
What coincidence!
entries.source:
Well bloat my belly! It's a human Earthling!
Har! Har! Har! Haven't seen a human Earthling since... since

What coincidence!
entries.translation:
我的肚皮要脹破了！ 是人類地球人！
哈！哈！哈！從…… 從什麼時候就沒見過人類地 球人
哎呀！從來沒見過人類地球 人！
真巧！

entries.label: SPACE_PRE_ZOMBIE_HELLO_2
entries.body:
Hi there human! How old fluid sacks today?
What?! You don't HAVE fluid sacks?
Har! Har! Har! What do you call your mate then?!! Har! Har! Har!...
you don't HAVE a mate?
THAT'S EVEN FUNNIER! Har! Har! Har!
entries.source:
Hi there human! How old fluid sacks today?
What?! You don't HAVE fluid sacks?
Har! Har! Har! What do you call your mate then?!! Har! Har! Har!...
you don't HAVE a mate?
THAT'S EVEN FUNNIER! Har! Har! Har!
entries.translation:
你好啊，人類！ 今天老液囊好嗎？
什麼？！你沒有液囊？
哈！哈！哈！那你怎麼稱呼 配偶？！！哈！哈！ 哈！……
你沒有配偶？
那更好笑！哈！哈！哈！

entries.label: SPACE_PRE_ZOMBIE_HELLO_3
entries.body:
Hi there, human Earthling! What'cha here for today?
What? Can't quite hear you? You'll have to speak up!
Hey! What problem here?
Human Earthling making fun of me?
THIS SOME KIND OF STUPID HUMAN EARTHLING TRICK? BECAUSE IF IS
Har! Har! Har!... fooled ya, didn't I?

entries.translation:
你好啊，人類地球人！ 今天來幹嘛？
什麼？聽不太清楚？ 你得大聲點！
嘿！這裡有什麼問題？
人類地球人在取笑我？
這是某種愚蠢的人類地球人 把戲？如果是的話
哈！哈！哈！…… 騙到你了，對不對？

entries.label: SPACE_PRE_ZOMBIE_HELLO_4
entries.body: Yo! Human Earthling! What up?!  Har! Har! Har!
entries.source: Yo! Human Earthling! What up?!  Har! Har! Har!
entries.translation: 唷！人類地球人！幹嘛 呀？！  哈！哈！哈！

entries.label: UNKNOWN_ZOMBIE_HELLO_1
entries.body:
HELLO. HUMAN. EARTHLING.
HAR.  HAR.  HAR.
entries.source:
HELLO. HUMAN. EARTHLING.
HAR.  HAR.  HAR.
entries.translation:
你好。人類。地球人。
哈。  哈。  哈。

entries.label: UNKNOWN_ZOMBIE_HELLO_2
entries.body:
HAPPY. GREETINGS. AND. WELCOME. EARTHLING. HUMAN.
HAR.  HAR.  HAR.
entries.source:
HAPPY. GREETINGS. AND. WELCOME. EARTHLING. HUMAN.
HAR.  HAR.  HAR.
entries.translation:
快樂。問候。以及。歡迎。 地球人。人類。
哈。  哈。  哈。

entries.label: UNKNOWN_ZOMBIE_HELLO_3
entries.body:
WHAT. SO. FUNNY. HUMAN. EARTHLING. YOUR. FACE. FUNNY. THING.
HAR.  HAR.  HAR.
entries.source:
WHAT. SO. FUNNY. HUMAN. EARTHLING. YOUR. FACE. FUNNY. THING.
HAR.  HAR.  HAR.
entries.translation:
什麼。這麼。好笑。人類。 地球人。你的。臉。好笑。 東西。
哈。  哈。  哈。

WE. FUNNY. UMGAH. SO. FUNNY.
HAR.  HAR.  HAR.
entries.source:
WE. FUNNY. UMGAH. SO. FUNNY.
HAR.  HAR.  HAR.
entries.translation:
我們。好笑。烏姆加。 非常。好笑。
哈。  哈。  哈。

entries.label: DESTROY_INTERFERER_1
entries.body:
THE. HUMAN. INTERFERES. WITH. PLAN.
KILL. IT.
entries.source:
THE. HUMAN. INTERFERES. WITH. PLAN.
KILL. IT.
entries.translation:
人類。干擾。計畫。
殺。它。

entries.label: DESTROY_INTERFERER_2
entries.body: STOP. THE. HUMAN. DESTROY. VESSEL.
entries.source: STOP. THE. HUMAN. DESTROY. VESSEL.
entries.translation: 阻止。人類。摧毀。船艦。

entries.label: DESTROY_INTERFERER_3
entries.body:
NO. DELAYS. IN. PLAN. TOLERATED.
ELIMINATE. HUMAN.
entries.source:
NO. DELAYS. IN. PLAN. TOLERATED.
ELIMINATE. HUMAN.
entries.translation:
計畫。不容。延誤。
消滅。人類。

entries.label: DESTROY_INTERFERER_4
entries.body: DESTROY. HUMAN. IMMEDIATELY.
entries.source: DESTROY. HUMAN. IMMEDIATELY.
entries.translation: 立即。摧毀。人類。

entries.label: REVEALED_ZOMBIE_HELLO_1
entries.body: HUMAN. KNOWS. TOO. MUCH. IT. MUST. NOT. ESCAPE.
entries.source: HUMAN. KNOWS. TOO. MUCH. IT. MUST. NOT. ESCAPE.
entries.translation: 人類。知道。太多。它。 絕對。不能。逃脫。

entries.label: REVEALED_ZOMBIE_HELLO_2
entries.body: HUMAN. EARTHLING. CEASE. MOTION. AND. DE-ENERGIZE. SHIP. SO. WE. CAN. GIVE. GIFT.
entries.source: HUMAN. EARTHLING. CEASE. MOTION. AND. DE-ENERGIZE. SHIP. SO. WE. CAN. GIVE. GIFT.
entries.translation: 人類。地球人。停止。 移動。並。關閉。船艦。 能量。如此。我們。可以。 贈送。禮物。

entries.label: REVEALED_ZOMBIE_HELLO_3
entries.body: CEASE. HOSTILITIES. WE. HAVE. CHANGED. OUR. MINDS. WE. LIKE. YOU. COME. CLOSER.
entries.source: CEASE. HOSTILITIES. WE. HAVE. CHANGED. OUR. MINDS. WE. LIKE. YOU. COME. CLOSER.
entries.translation: 停止。敵對。我們。已經。 改變。想法。我們。喜歡。 你。靠近。一點。

entries.label: REVEALED_ZOMBIE_HELLO_4
entries.body: RESISTANCE. IS. USELESS. HUMAN. EARTHLING.
entries.source: RESISTANCE. IS. USELESS. HUMAN. EARTHLING.
entries.translation: 抵抗。沒有。用。人類。 地球人。

entries.label: HOSTILE_HELLO_1
entries.body:
Hello human Earthling savior!
Although we appreciate your efforts on our behalf
we really hate `Eternal Gratitude' stuff, so we've decided to kill you now.
Har! Har! Har! We pretty crazy blobbies, no?!
entries.source:
Hello human Earthling savior!
Although we appreciate your efforts on our behalf
we really hate `Eternal Gratitude' stuff, so we've decided to kill you now.
Har! Har! Har! We pretty crazy blobbies, no?!
entries.translation:
你好，人類地球人救星！
雖然我們感謝你為我們付出 努力
但我們實在討厭「永恆感 激」那套，所以決定現在殺 掉你。
哈！哈！哈！我們是很瘋狂 團塊，對不對？！

entries.label: HOSTILE_HELLO_2
entries.body:
Well pop my pupae! It human Earthling again!
It just doesn't learn, does it? To Arms! To Arms!... wait a minute! Don't HAVE any arms!
AIEE!! MY ARMS!! MY ARMS!! WHO HAS STOLEN MY ARMS!!! AIEEE!! ARM THIEF!!!
Har! Har! Har!... Never HAD any arms! Har! Har! Har!

entries.translation:
我的蛹要爆了！ 又是人類地球人！
它就是學不會，對不對？ 拿起武器！拿起武器！…… 等一下！根本沒有手臂！
咿呀！！我的手臂！！ 我的手臂！！誰偷了我的手 臂！！！咿呀！！ 手臂小偷！！！
哈！哈！哈！…… 從來沒有手臂！哈！哈！ 哈！

entries.label: HOSTILE_HELLO_3
entries.body:
Look, we all decided that our treating you this way,
attacking you without mercy all time,
well, we decided that it just plain unfair.
REALLY, after all things you've done for our people!
So we decided to make you our honorary KING! Congratulations!
Braankk!!
What that sound, officer Flubbo? It was? You sure? King-Killing Horn?
Har! Har! Har! What a sad coincidence, eh, Captain King?

聽著，我們都決定， 這樣對待你，
一直毫不留情攻擊你，
嗯，我們決定這實在不公 平。
真的，畢竟你為我們族人做 了那麼多事！
所以我們決定封你為榮譽國 王！恭喜！
噗嚕昂！！
那什麼聲音，Flubbo 軍官？是嗎？你確定？ 弒王號角？
哈！哈！哈！多麼悲傷的巧 合，對吧，艦長國王？

entries.label: HOSTILE_HELLO_4
entries.body:
Ho-ho! Human Earthling has returned to claim its reward!
What reward you ask? Why this reward, of course!
entries.source:
Ho-ho! Human Earthling has returned to claim its reward!
What reward you ask? Why this reward, of course!
entries.translation:
呵呵！人類地球人回來領獎 賞！
你問什麼獎賞？ 當然是這個獎賞！

entries.label: REWARD_AT_HOMEWORLD_1
entries.body:
Hurray! Hurray! It human Earthling! Our Savior!!
Oh hurry, human Earthling, HURRY! Your reward awaits at our homeworld!
In case you have forgotten, that at Beta Orionis!
Hurry, human Earthling, HURRY!
entries.source:

Oh hurry, human Earthling, HURRY! Your reward awaits at our homeworld!
In case you have forgotten, that at Beta Orionis!
Hurry, human Earthling, HURRY!
entries.translation:
萬歲！萬歲！是人類地球 人！我們的救星！！
喔，快點，人類地球人， 快點！你的獎賞在我們母星 等著！
怕你忘了，那裡在 Beta Orionis！
快點，人類地球人，快點！

entries.label: REWARD_AT_HOMEWORLD_2
entries.body:
Hust! Hust! You must make haste, human Earthling!
Sooner you go to our homeworld at Beta Orionis
sooner you shall receive your reward!
entries.source:
Hust! Hust! You must make haste, human Earthling!
Sooner you go to our homeworld at Beta Orionis
sooner you shall receive your reward!
entries.translation:
快！快！你必須趕快， 人類地球人！
越早去我們在 Beta Orionis 的母星
就越早拿到獎賞！

entries.label: POST_ZOMBIE_HWLD_HELLO
entries.body:
HAIL! HAIL! Human Earthling! GREAT HERO HAS RETURNED!
Oh, my lipids quivering just looking at him on monitor!
What smile! What sparkling eyes! What nice bony structure!
He one who has saved us from mental compulsion of evil Talking Pet!
HAIL! HAIL! HAIL!
Oh Great Hero! We grateful species! Speak to us! How we reward you?!

entries.translation:
萬歲！萬歲！人類地球人！ 偉大英雄回來了！
喔，看著監視器上的他， 我的脂質都在顫抖！
多麼燦爛的笑容！ 多麼閃亮的眼睛！ 多麼漂亮的骨骼結構！
他就是從邪惡會說話的寵物 心靈控制下拯救我們的人！
萬歲！萬歲！萬歲！
喔，偉大英雄！ 我們是感激物種！ 跟我們說話！我們怎麼獎勵 你？！

entries.label: owe_me_big_time
entries.body: Yup! That's right! You guys owe me BIG time.
entries.source: Yup! That's right! You guys owe me BIG time.
entries.translation: 沒錯！就是這樣！ 你們這些傢伙欠我一大筆。

entries.label: our_largesse
entries.body: Gentle blobbies, please calm yourselves. We act solely from largesse. Rewards are unnecessary.
entries.source: Gentle blobbies, please calm yourselves. We act solely from largesse. Rewards are unnecessary.
entries.translation: 各位團塊先生，請冷靜。 我們只是慷慨行事， 不需要獎賞。

entries.label: GIVE_LIFEDATA
entries.body:
We must reward your deeds of courage!
Killing Talking Pet was a feat none of our species could perform!
You superior! You Hero!
HAIL! HAIL! HAIL!
We MUST reward you!... but what do we have to give?
Protoplasm?... no, no, not easily appreciated.
Vigorous esters?... no, too common.
HAVE IT! HAVE IT! GENETIC MODIFICATION!! YES! IT PERFECT GIFT!!
Listen human Earthling! We add some extra eyes! A few tentacles!
Other organs of whatever size and shape you desire!!
What?! You not want more organs?... You sure?... How strange... how sad.
This was best gift. We Umgah have nothing but vast supply of biological skills and data.
Huh? What you say?
You want Biological Data?! Just plain raw Biological Data?
What you do with it?
Oh, well, you Hero. Whatever you want, you get.

entries.translation:
我們必須獎勵你的勇敢事 蹟！
殺死會說話的寵物， 是我們物種沒人做得到的壯 舉！
你優越！你英雄！
萬歲！萬歲！萬歲！
我們必須獎勵你！…… 但我們有什麼可以送？
原生質？……不，不， 不容易欣賞。
活潑的酯類？……不， 太常見。
有了！有了！基因改造！！ 對！這是完美禮物！！
聽著，人類地球人！ 我們加幾顆眼睛！ 幾根觸手！
還有你想要的任何尺寸、 任何形狀的其他器官！！
什麼？！你不想要更多器 官？……確定？…… 真奇怪……真悲傷。
這是最好禮物。 我們烏姆加除大量生物技術 和資料，什麼都沒有。
啊？你說什麼？
你想要生物資料？！ 就只是普通原始生物資料？
你要拿來做什麼？
喔，好吧，你是英雄。 你想要什麼，就得到什麼。

entries.label: what_do_with_tpet
entries.body: So how did that Talking Pet get control of your species?
entries.source: So how did that Talking Pet get control of your species?
entries.translation: 那隻會說話的寵物是怎麼控 制你們整個物種的？

entries.label: TRICK_URQUAN
entries.body:
Ah, well Arilou Lalee'lay, who kind of our neighbors, gave us Talking Pet
hoping we could heal it more severe injuries, which we did.
While we working on it, we do routine brain structure scan
and discovered that creature have extremely sophisticated set of neural pathways
even more complex than own!
Further analysis showed that with minor genetic manipulations
Talking Pet intelligence greatly expanded, perhaps even to sentience!
Little did know what monster we creating.
Only few hours after injected nanots with modification program, creature wakes up.
Almost immediately, took control of Hospital... then city... then whole planet.
We try to resist, but creature, even in drugged, weakened state, too strong.
From that day on, we just mindless slaves who live only serve Talking Pet, and `Big Plan'.
What `Big Plan'?
We never quite sure about details of `Big Plan', except it involved getting revenge
and mean LOTS of revenge...
against Ur-Quan masters.

entries.translation:
啊，嗯，算是我們鄰居的阿 里盧・拉萊萊， 把會說話的寵物交給我們
希望我們治好它比較嚴重的 傷，我們做到了。
我們處理它時， 照例掃描大腦結構
結果發現那生物有極其精密 的神經通路
甚至比我們自己的更複雜！
進一步分析顯示， 只要稍作基因操控
會說話的寵物智力就能大幅 擴展，甚至可能產生智慧！
我們根本不知道自己創造了 什麼怪物。
注入帶有改造程式的奈米機 器後，只過幾小時， 那生物醒來。
幾乎立刻控制醫院…… 接著城市……接著整顆行 星。
我們試著抵抗， 但生物即使遭藥物削弱， 還是太強。
從那天起，我們只是沒有心 智的奴隸，活著只為服侍會 說話的寵物和「大計畫」。
什麼「大計畫」？
我們從沒完全弄清楚「大計 畫」細節，只知道和復仇有 關
而且是很多很多復仇……
針對烏爾關主人。

entries.label: any_jokes
entries.body: Why the Ur-Quan? What did it have against them?
entries.source: Why the Ur-Quan? What did it have against them?
entries.translation: 為什麼是烏爾關？ 它和他們有什麼仇？

entries.label: SURE
entries.body:
We don't know, but whatever it was, must been pretty bad
because Talking Pet mad... REAL mad! How mad, you ask?
Blowing up planets and eating juveniles mad! That how mad.
We got impression Ur-Quan did something awful to Talking Pet or maybe even whole species.
Whatever it was, it worse than slavery
maybe even worse than death.
entries.source:
We don't know, but whatever it was, must been pretty bad
because Talking Pet mad... REAL mad! How mad, you ask?
Blowing up planets and eating juveniles mad! That how mad.
We got impression Ur-Quan did something awful to Talking Pet or maybe even whole species.
Whatever it was, it worse than slavery
maybe even worse than death.
entries.translation:
我們不知道，但不管是什 麼，一定非常糟
因為會說話的寵物很生 氣……真的很生氣！ 你問多生氣？
氣到會炸掉行星、 吃掉幼體！就是那麼生氣。
我們感覺烏爾關對會說話的 寵物，甚至可能對整個物種 做了可怕的事。
不管是什麼，比奴役更糟
甚至可能比死亡更糟。

entries.label: what_before_tpet
entries.body: So what should I do with the Talking Pet?
entries.source: So what should I do with the Talking Pet?
entries.translation: 那我該怎麼處理會說話的寵 物？

entries.label: TRKD_SPATHI_AND_ILWRATH
entries.body:
You mean, CORPSE of Talking Pet, don't you Captain?!
DID kill it, didn't you?!
entries.source:
You mean, CORPSE of Talking Pet, don't you Captain?!
DID kill it, didn't you?!
entries.translation:
你是說會說話的寵物屍體， 對不對，艦長？！
你有殺掉它，對不對？！

entries.label: where_caster
entries.body: Er... yeah! That's right. Real dead. So what should I do with its corpse?
entries.source: Er... yeah! That's right. Real dead. So what should I do with its corpse?
entries.translation: 呃……對！沒錯。死透了。 那我該怎麼處理屍體？

entries.label: SPATHI_TOOK_THEM
entries.body:
Hmmm... as general rule, corpses aren't too much fun.
When we were first starting to mess with its brain
our intention to get it smart enough to accept orders from us
and then repeat them as though they legitimate Ur-Quan commands.
Har! Har! Har! Har! We going to play little joke this way!
We going to use Talking Pet to order Spathi to attack VUX!
Har! Har Har! That been great! ZAP! ZAP! KABOOM!!! Har! Har! Har!...
...even better than old Dogar and Kazon routine we pull on Ilwrath few years back
before those spoil-sport Spathi stole super cool HyperWave `Caster.
entries.source:
Hmmm... as general rule, corpses aren't too much fun.
When we were first starting to mess with its brain
our intention to get it smart enough to accept orders from us
and then repeat them as though they legitimate Ur-Quan commands.
Har! Har! Har! Har! We going to play little joke this way!
We going to use Talking Pet to order Spathi to attack VUX!
Har! Har Har! That been great! ZAP! ZAP! KABOOM!!! Har! Har! Har!...
...even better than old Dogar and Kazon routine we pull on Ilwrath few years back
before those spoil-sport Spathi stole super cool HyperWave `Caster.
entries.translation:
嗯……一般來說， 屍體沒多少樂趣。
我們一開始亂動它的大腦時
本來想讓它聰明到能接受我 們的命令
然後把命令重複得像是合法 烏爾關命令。
哈！哈！哈！哈！ 我們本來要用這方法開個小 玩笑！
我們要用會說話的寵物命令 斯帕西攻擊 VUX！
哈！哈！哈！那會很棒！ 滋！滋！轟隆！！！哈！ 哈！哈！……
……甚至比幾年前對伊爾拉 斯玩的多加爾和卡宗老把戲 更好
那是在掃興的斯帕西偷走超 酷超波發射器之前。

entries.label: so_what_for_now
entries.body: So, since I'm your Great Hero Guy, tell me all your secrets.
entries.source: So, since I'm your Great Hero Guy, tell me all your secrets.
entries.translation: 既然我是你們的偉大英雄先 生，就把所有祕密告訴我。

entries.label: DO_THIS_NOW
entries.body:
Secrets, huh? You want secrets? OUR SECRETS!? YOU MADE FATAL MISTAKE, HUMAN!!
... Har! Har! Har! Good joke, eh? Scared you!
Sure! We'll tell our secrets. Now let me see... what ARE secrets?
Oh, yes!... remember! It about Mycons!
You see, Mycons only other race we know of
that have same kind of biotechincal skills as Umgah.
But amazing thing, they do all with their own bodies, don't need tools.
They just THINK genetic modification, and it happen!
We found that pretty hard understand, so when nobody looking, we clonk one on head
bring it back here to homeworld and slice it up for detailed study.
Those guys not product of ANY natural evolutionary process
they constructs!... some kind of multi-purpose biological tool.
We don't know who made them or for what purpose
but they WAY beyond anything we ever heard of.
We not figure out much more before tissue samples all gross
so guess that pretty much all of big secret.
Oh... do us favor? Please not tell anybody about clonking Mycon.
It kind of against Ur-Quan Laws, and not want get Mycons mad at us.

... Har! Har! Har! Good joke, eh? Scared you!
Sure! We'll tell our secrets. Now let me see... what ARE secrets?
Oh, yes!... remember! It about Mycons!
You see, Mycons only other race we know of

entries.translation:
祕密，啊？你想要祕密？ 我們的祕密！？ 你犯了致命錯誤，人類！！
……哈！哈！哈！好笑話， 對不對？嚇到你了！
當然！我們會告訴你祕密。 現在讓我想想…… 什麼是祕密？
喔，對！……想起來了！ 是關於邁康！
你看，邁康是我們知道的唯 一另一個種族
擁有和烏姆加同類型的生物 技術能力。
但驚人的是，他們全部用自 己身體完成，不需要工具。
他們只要想著基因改造， 事情就發生！
我們覺得很難理解， 所以沒人看見時， 我們敲昏一個
帶回母星切開，詳細研究。
那些傢伙不是任何自然演化 過程的產物
他們是人造物！…… 某種多用途生物工具。
我們不知道誰製造他們， 或為了什麼目的
但他們遠遠超越我們聽過的 一切。
組織樣本全部變噁心前， 我們沒查出更多
所以大祕密差不多就這些。
喔……幫我們個忙？ 請不要告訴別人敲昏邁康的 事。
這有點違反烏爾關法律， 我們也不想讓邁康生氣。

entries.label: bye_post_zombie
entries.body: Well, your Great Hero must leave now, but rest assured, I'll be back.
entries.source: Well, your Great Hero must leave now, but rest assured, I'll be back.
entries.translation: 嗯，你們的偉大英雄現在得 離開，但放心， 我還會回來。

entries.label: FUNNY_IDEA
entries.body:
You know, Great Hero... I getting this funny feeling.
Would like to know what feeling is? Good, I tell you.
My feeling that Great Hero stuff... well, boring... not funny at all.
You only say HAIL! HAIL! HAIL! so many times before starts to lose appeal,
so... instituting slight deviation in course of our relationship.
Specifically, instead of being dull and lifeless Great Hero
you now glamorous and exciting... Great Enemy!
We give you some our Drone ships to make even more interesting!
Yes! This going to be LOTS more fun!
Here... let me show you.
entries.source:
You know, Great Hero... I getting this funny feeling.
Would like to know what feeling is? Good, I tell you.
My feeling that Great Hero stuff... well, boring... not funny at all.
You only say HAIL! HAIL! HAIL! so many times before starts to lose appeal,
so... instituting slight deviation in course of our relationship.
Specifically, instead of being dull and lifeless Great Hero
you now glamorous and exciting... Great Enemy!
We give you some our Drone ships to make even more interesting!
Yes! This going to be LOTS more fun!
Here... let me show you.
entries.translation:
你知道嗎，偉大英雄…… 我開始有種好笑的感覺。
想知道什麼感覺？很好， 我告訴你。
我的感覺是偉大英雄這 套……嗯，很無聊…… 一點都不好笑。
萬歲！萬歲！萬歲！ 喊太多次，就開始失去吸引 力，
所以……稍微偏轉一下我們 關係的路線。
具體來說，你不再是沉悶無 趣的偉大英雄
你現在是迷人刺激的…… 偉大敵人！
我們會送你幾艘無人機， 讓事情更有趣！
沒錯！這樣會好玩很多很 多！
來……讓我示範。

entries.label: whats_up_pre_zombie
entries.body: Umgah! Reveal your secrets!
entries.source: Umgah! Reveal your secrets!
entries.translation: 烏姆加！揭露你們的祕密！

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_PRE_ZOMBIE
entries.body:
Okay, since you ask so nicely, we will tell you a thing or two.
For instance, did know that even now we performing surgery on Talking Pet?
Arilou found it alone and dying in wreck of Ur-Quan Dreadnought on Alpha Pavonis.
They couldn't heal so they brought to us.
We discovered that animal has potential for high intelligence
provided we make few minor genetic modifications.
entries.source:
Okay, since you ask so nicely, we will tell you a thing or two.
For instance, did know that even now we performing surgery on Talking Pet?
Arilou found it alone and dying in wreck of Ur-Quan Dreadnought on Alpha Pavonis.
They couldn't heal so they brought to us.
We discovered that animal has potential for high intelligence
provided we make few minor genetic modifications.
entries.translation:
好，既然你問得這麼有禮 貌，我們就告訴你一兩件 事。
例如，你知不知道我們現在 還在替會說話的寵物動手 術？
阿里盧在 Alpha Pavonis 的烏爾關無畏艦殘骸中發現 它獨自等死。
他們治不好，就把它帶給我 們。
我們發現這動物有獲得高等 智慧的潛力
只要做幾項小小基因改造。

entries.label: evil_blobbies_give_up
entries.body: Evil blobbies. You must submit to our overwhelming power!
entries.source: Evil blobbies. You must submit to our overwhelming power!
entries.translation: 邪惡團塊。你們必須臣服於 我們壓倒性的力量！

entries.label: NOT_EVIL_BLOBBIES
entries.body:
Har! Har! Har! GOOD JOKE!!
We use it on someone else real soon.
entries.source:
Har! Har! Har! GOOD JOKE!!
We use it on someone else real soon.
entries.translation:
哈！哈！哈！好笑話！！
我們很快拿去用在別人身 上。

entries.label: evil_blobbies_must_die
entries.body: No! I was serious. You ARE evil blobbies. You MUST die.
entries.source: No! I was serious. You ARE evil blobbies. You MUST die.
entries.translation: 不！我是認真的。 你們就是邪惡團塊。 你們必須死。

entries.label: OH_NO_WE_WONT
entries.body: Har! Har! Har! Even funnier!
entries.source: Har! Har! Har! Even funnier!
entries.translation: 哈！哈！哈！更好笑！

entries.label: can_we_be_friends
entries.body: Look, I know we've had our differences in the past, but can't we be friends?
entries.source: Look, I know we've had our differences in the past, but can't we be friends?
entries.translation: 聽著，我知道過去有些歧 見，但我們不能當朋友嗎？

entries.label: SURE_FRIENDS
entries.body:
Sure! Sure! Friends for sure!
Who cares about boring old Ur-Quan and their slave laws? Har! Har! Har!
Here we come to say hello to new friends!
entries.source:
Sure! Sure! Friends for sure!
Who cares about boring old Ur-Quan and their slave laws? Har! Har! Har!
Here we come to say hello to new friends!
entries.translation:
當然！當然！當然是朋友！
誰在乎沉悶老烏爾關和他們 的奴役法？哈！哈！哈！
我們現在就來跟新朋友打招 呼！

entries.label: want_to_defeat_urquan
entries.body: Here's our credo: Freedom from Ur-Quan! What do you say?
entries.source: Here's our credo: Freedom from Ur-Quan! What do you say?
entries.translation: 我們的信條是： 擺脫烏爾關，爭取自由！ 你們怎麼說？

entries.label: FINE_BY_US
entries.body:
Har! Har! Har! Freedom very good thing!
It so much easier to make good jokes without boring old Ur-Quan slave laws!
We wanting to pull real good one on those stupid nosers from Draconis for long time
but since they battle thralls too, we not allowed do even small pranks on them
like, say... dropping planetoid in their ocean.
Big waves! Big waves! Har! Har! Har!
entries.source:
Har! Har! Har! Freedom very good thing!
It so much easier to make good jokes without boring old Ur-Quan slave laws!
We wanting to pull real good one on those stupid nosers from Draconis for long time
but since they battle thralls too, we not allowed do even small pranks on them
like, say... dropping planetoid in their ocean.
Big waves! Big waves! Har! Har! Har!
entries.translation:
哈！哈！哈！自由是非常好 東西！
沒有沉悶老烏爾關奴役法， 開好笑話容易多了！
很久以來，我們一直想好好 整一次 Draconis 那些蠢鼻子
但他們也是戰奴， 所以我們連小小惡作劇都不 准對他們做
例如……把一顆微型行星丟 進他們海裡。
大浪！大浪！哈！哈！哈！

entries.label: bye_pre_zombie
entries.body: Well Umgah. It has been fascinating, but I must go.
entries.source: Well Umgah. It has been fascinating, but I must go.
entries.translation: 嗯，烏姆加，這很迷人， 但我得走了。

entries.label: GOODBYE_PRE_ZOMBIE
entries.body: Har! Har! Har! Hey wait human Earthling! Here best part!
entries.source: Har! Har! Har! Hey wait human Earthling! Here best part!
entries.translation: 哈！哈！哈！嘿，等等， 人類地球人！這裡是最好部 分！

entries.label: threat
entries.body: Evil blobbies, your craven nature is revealed! Submit!
entries.source: Evil blobbies, your craven nature is revealed! Submit!
entries.translation: 邪惡團塊，你們的懦弱本性 已經暴露！臣服吧！

entries.label: NO_THREAT
entries.body: IF. COMPREHEND. TRUE. NATURE. MUST. BE. ELIMINATED.
entries.source: IF. COMPREHEND. TRUE. NATURE. MUST. BE. ELIMINATED.
entries.translation: 若。理解。真正。本質。 就。必須。被。消滅。

entries.label: whats_up_zombies
entries.body: So Umgah, what have you been up to these past twenty years?
entries.source: So Umgah, what have you been up to these past twenty years?
entries.translation: 所以烏姆加，過去二十年你 們都在忙什麼？

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_ZOMBIE
entries.body: NOTHING. HAPPEN. LAST. TWENTY. YEARS. VERY. BORING.
entries.source: NOTHING. HAPPEN. LAST. TWENTY. YEARS. VERY. BORING.
entries.translation: 過去。二十。年。什麼。 都。沒發生。非常。無聊。

entries.label: how_goes_tpet
entries.body: So how goes your work on that Talking Pet?
entries.source: So how goes your work on that Talking Pet?
entries.translation: 那隻會說話的寵物改造得如 何？

entries.label: WHAT_TPET
entries.body: WHAT. TALKING. PET. DO. NOT. UNDERSTAND. REFERENCE.
entries.source: WHAT. TALKING. PET. DO. NOT. UNDERSTAND. REFERENCE.
entries.translation: 什麼。會說話的。寵物。 不。明白。指涉。

entries.label: you_told_us
entries.body: You told us you were modifying a Talking Pet, didn't you?
entries.source: You told us you were modifying a Talking Pet, didn't you?
entries.translation: 你們說過自己正在改造一隻 會說話的寵物，不是嗎？

entries.label: SADLY_IT_DIED
entries.body:
SADLY. IT. DIED.
NO. MORE. TALK. ABOUT. IT.
entries.source:
SADLY. IT. DIED.
NO. MORE. TALK. ABOUT. IT.
entries.translation:
遺憾。它。死了。
不要。再。談。這件事。

entries.label: dont_believe
entries.body: You know, I just don't believe you. What are you hiding?
entries.source: You know, I just don't believe you. What are you hiding?
entries.translation: 你知道嗎，我就是不相信。 你們在隱瞞什麼？

entries.label: THEN_DIE
entries.body:
HUMAN. POSSESSES. FORBIDDEN. KNOWLEDGE.
NO. INTERFERENCE. IN. PLAN. CAN. BE. TOLERATED.
HUMAN. MUST. BE. ELIMINATED.
entries.source:
HUMAN. POSSESSES. FORBIDDEN. KNOWLEDGE.
NO. INTERFERENCE. IN. PLAN. CAN. BE. TOLERATED.
HUMAN. MUST. BE. ELIMINATED.
entries.translation:
人類。擁有。禁忌。知識。
不容。干擾。計畫。
人類。必須。被。消滅。

entries.label: bye_unknown
entries.body: If I try to leave, are you going to attack me?
entries.source: If I try to leave, are you going to attack me?
entries.translation: 如果我想離開， 你們會攻擊我嗎？

entries.label: GOODBYE_UNKNOWN
entries.body: NO. LEAVE.
entries.source: NO. LEAVE.
entries.translation: 不會。離開。

entries.label: evil_blobbies
entries.body: You are evil blobbies, I say! Avast!
entries.source: You are evil blobbies, I say! Avast!
entries.translation: 我說你們是邪惡團塊！ 站住！

entries.label: YES_VERY_EVIL
entries.body:
YES. WE. ARE. VERY. EVIL.
YOUR. BEST. PLAN. IS. TO. DEPART. AND. NEVER. RETURN.
entries.source:
YES. WE. ARE. VERY. EVIL.
YOUR. BEST. PLAN. IS. TO. DEPART. AND. NEVER. RETURN.
entries.translation:
對。我們。非常。邪惡。
你。最好。現在。離開。 而且。永不。返回。

entries.label: give_up_or_die
entries.body: Surrender to me HERE and NOW or I shall vaporize you!
entries.source: Surrender to me HERE and NOW or I shall vaporize you!
entries.translation: 現在立刻向我投降， 否則我就蒸發你們！

entries.label: NOT_GIVE_UP
entries.body:
HUMAN. INTERFERENCE. REACHES. INTOLERABLE. LEVEL.
PLAN. MUST. NOT. BE. DELAYED.
ELIMINATE. HUMAN.
entries.source:
HUMAN. INTERFERENCE. REACHES. INTOLERABLE. LEVEL.
PLAN. MUST. NOT. BE. DELAYED.
ELIMINATE. HUMAN.
entries.translation:
人類。干擾。達到。 無法容忍。程度。
計畫。絕對。不能。延誤。
消滅。人類。

entries.label: we_vindicator0
entries.body: I am Captain
entries.source: I am Captain
entries.translation: 我是艦長

entries.label: we_vindicator1
entries.body: , of the starship
entries.source: , of the starship
entries.translation: ，我的星艦是

entries.label: we_vindicator2
entries.body: . What is your response?
entries.source: . What is your response?
entries.translation: 。你們有何回應？

entries.label: GOOD_FOR_YOU_1
entries.body:
WE. RESPOND. WITH. APPROPRIATE. AWE. AND. RESPECT.
NOW. GO. AWAY.
entries.source:
WE. RESPOND. WITH. APPROPRIATE. AWE. AND. RESPECT.
NOW. GO. AWAY.
entries.translation:
我們。回應。以。適當。 敬畏。與。尊重。
現在。離開。

entries.label: come_in_peace
entries.body: Our message is Peace Between All Species!... blobbies included.
entries.source: Our message is Peace Between All Species!... blobbies included.
entries.translation: 我們的訊息是各物種和平共 處！……團塊也包括在內。

entries.label: GOOD_FOR_YOU_2
entries.body:
YES. PEACE. GOOD. WE. WANT. PEACE. ALSO.
DEMONSTRATE. PEACE. NOW. BY. DEPARTING. OUR. SPACE. IMMEDIATELY.
entries.source:
YES. PEACE. GOOD. WE. WANT. PEACE. ALSO.
DEMONSTRATE. PEACE. NOW. BY. DEPARTING. OUR. SPACE. IMMEDIATELY.
entries.translation:
是的。和平。很好。我們。 也想要。和平。
現在。立刻。離開。我們。 領空。以此。展現。和平。

entries.label: know_any_jokes
entries.body: Umgah humor is renowned across space, so... know any good jokes?!
entries.source: Umgah humor is renowned across space, so... know any good jokes?!
entries.translation: 烏姆加式幽默聞名太空， 所以……知道什麼好笑話 嗎？！

entries.label: JOKE_1
entries.body:
JOKE. YES. JOKE. HERE. IS. JOKE.
WHEN. IS. A. SLAVE. NOT. A. SLAVE.
ANSWER.
WHEN. HE. IS. A. SLAVE. MASTER.
HAR.  HAR.  HAR.
entries.source:
JOKE. YES. JOKE. HERE. IS. JOKE.

entries.label: not_very_funny
entries.body: Ugh! That wasn't a very good joke either. I don't think you guys are very funny.

entries.translation: 呃！那也不是什麼好笑話。 我覺得你們一點都不好笑。

entries.label: what_about_tpet
entries.body: So how's that Talking Pet getting along?

entries.label: arilou_told_us
entries.body: The Arilou told us they had given it to you... they did, right?
entries.source: The Arilou told us they had given it to you... they did, right?
entries.translation: 阿里盧告訴我們， 他們把它交給你們了…… 真的有吧？

entries.label: bye_zombie
entries.body: Goodbye Umgah. I wish I could say it's been fun.
entries.source: Goodbye Umgah. I wish I could say it's been fun.
entries.translation: 再見，烏姆加。 真希望我能說這段時間很有 趣。

entries.label: GOODBYE_ZOMBIE
entries.body: GOODBYE. HUMAN. EARTHLING. DO. NOT. RETURN.
entries.source: GOODBYE. HUMAN. EARTHLING. DO. NOT. RETURN.
entries.translation: 再見。人類。地球人。 不要。回來。
